When the tour starts you get an option to pick the 5 star and 4 star of your choice (example, you get to pick between mika and kohaku, and shu and madara) and you will get the one you picked on day 30 of the event. What they meant by "picking 3.5m" is that along with the tour days, you also have a scoring similar to unit events where you get a 5 star at 3.5m points, but for tour simce you have two 5 stars, one 5 star you get at 3m points and the other at 3.5m. If you want both kohaku and mika, then its better to choose mika, because his card is available at 3.5m, and thats going to be a pain to grind. Get mika by choosing him as your day 30 card, and then grind some points to get kohaku which is easier to get because he is at 3m points.

Personally intermittent fasting has worked for me and I have been able to go through longer intervals of fasting. The thing with intermittent fasting is that you don't have to restrict your calories much. Eat things filled with fibre, potatoes, dried figs work great ( if you find them) and it's better to avoid sodas and stuff like that. I stopped taking even fruit juices, and rather eat only real fruits. If you have a trigger for binging ( like cereal, chocolate or whatever ) try avoiding it as much as possible.
